primary_metric: valid completed candidate-selection fraction across all planned study calls on a batch with verified runtime integrity
secondary_metrics: ID and skill stability across complete triplets; missing triplets reported
distinct-skill normalized mastery mid-rank with single-skill exclusions and planned-call coverage
display and enum position counts and first-position fractions
latency including failures with separate scope for local baseline computation
paired graph sensitivity and soft remediation against the same author-proposed reference graph
rank_contract: exact mastery equality; average ranks over distinct candidate skills; (rank-1)/(k-1); undefined k=1; all tied k>1 gives 0.5
random_reference: uniform IDs weighted by item counts per skill; exact expected rank and lowest-skill probability; ID stability 1/m^2, skill stability sum((n_s/m)^3) for independent draws on fixed membership
supplementary_metric: agreement with B+; disagreement is not an error or proof of inferior pedagogy
reason_review: model-anonymized Agent rationale rubric only; cross-policy blinding requires comparable baseline explanations; no automatic semantic or pedagogical quality score
claims: operational metadata selection only; no learning gain, verified mastery or educational-quality claim
limit: one predeclared development batch on previously inspected scenarios; no model/prompt sweep or TEST access
